Definition: from G1909 and a derivative of G3700; to inspect, i.e. watch:--behold.
BiblicalUsage: epopteúō is the word for to inspect. It occurs twice, in 1 Peter.
TheologicalSignificance: I take epopteúō as it stands — to inspect — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
